subject: public disturbance and disorder
fact: Thorin was involved in the altercation with the deranged stone giant, contributing to the ensuing public disorder.
source_quote: Public Disturbance and Disorder: Thorin was involved in the altercation with the deranged stone giant. While he claims to have wanted to subdue the giant, his actions could be interpreted as contributing to the ensuing public disorder.

subject: interference with city watch
fact: Thorin attempted to influence and direct the actions of the Duergar City Watch during the incident with the stone giant, which can be seen as obstruction.
source_quote: Interference with City Watch: Thorin attempted to influence and direct the actions of the Duergar City Watch during the aforementioned incident with the stone giant. While he claims he was trying to help, any interference with the watch's official duties can be seen as obstruction and a challenge to their authority.

subject: questioning authority
fact: Thorin has repeatedly questioned the authority and motives of various Duergar individuals and factions, including the Keepers of the Flame, which is not tolerated.
source_quote: Questioning Authority: Thorin has repeatedly questioned the authority and motives of various Duergar individuals and factions, including the Keepers of the Flame. Such questioning can be perceived as dissent and disrespect, which is not tolerated within Gracklstugh's hierarchical society.

subject: unauthorized access
fact: Thorin may have entered areas restricted to non-Duergar citizens without proper authorization, even with the passes.
source_quote: Unauthorized Access: Depending on his movements within the city, Thorin may have entered areas restricted to non-Duergar citizens without proper authorization, even with the passes. Any unauthorized access to restricted areas is a violation of city ordinances.

subject: association with undesirables
fact: Thorin has been seen associating with individuals of questionable character, including other surface dwellers and individuals who may be considered enemies of the state.
source_quote: Association with Undesirables: Thorin has been seen associating with individuals of questionable character, including other surface dwellers and individuals who may be considered enemies of the state. Such associations can raise suspicion and lead to accusations of conspiracy, aiding, and abetting.

subject: possession of unauthorized items
fact: If Thorin is found to own any items considered contraband or restricted within Gracklstugh, such as certain weapons or magical items, he will violate the law.
source_quote: Possession of Unauthorized Items: If Thorin is found to own any items considered contraband or restricted within Gracklstugh, such as certain weapons or magical items, he will violate the law.

subject: suspicion of espionage
fact: Given his questioning and interest in the city's affairs, including the Keepers of the Flame and Themberchaud, Thorin is suspected of espionage or gathering intelligence for potentially hostile entities.
source_quote: Suspicion of Espionage: Given his questioning and interest in the city's affairs, including the Keepers of the Flame and Themberchaud, Thorin is suspected of espionage or gathering intelligence for potentially hostile entities. This is a grave offense with severe consequences.

subject: general suspicion
fact: As a non-Duergar, Thorin is already subject to suspicion and scrutiny within Gracklstugh, and any deviation from expected behavior can lead to arrest and imprisonment.
source_quote: General Suspicion: As a non-Duergar, Thorin is already subject to suspicion and scrutiny within Gracklstugh. Any deviation from expected behavior or any action that could be interpreted as threatening to the city's stability can lead to arrest and imprisonment.

subject: shared disclosure of the egg
fact: Thorin says if they get arrested, they will have to tell the Stone Guards about the egg.
source_quote: Thorin stares at him. “I am just putting all of our cards on the table. So if we get arrested, we will have to tell the Stone Guards about the egg, right?”

subject: disaster of revealing the egg
fact: Gartokkar says sharing the egg’s existence would be a disaster.
source_quote: Gartokkar turns dark and then smiles, “You joke? Sharing that would be a disaster.”

subject: request for the egg and proof of the Gray Ghosts
fact: Gartokkar tells Thorin to find the egg and the proof of the Gray Ghosts.
source_quote: Just find me the egg and the proof of the Gray Ghosts.

subject: flashing the right badge at the right time
fact: Daz asks if they should flash the right badge at the right time.
source_quote: Daz turns to Thorin while looking at his collection of badges, “So we flash the right one at the right time?”

subject: riding the Dragon out of Gracklstugh
fact: Thorin proposes riding the Dragon out of the city, laying waste to everything behind them, as factions are playing them against each other.
source_quote: Thorin nods. And then he has a peculiar glint in his eye. He turns to Grygum, “I have an idea. These factions are all trying to play us against each other, and this Dragon is one of us. So what if we ride this Dragon out of here, laying waste to everything behind us?”

subject: cleric of Bahamut's outrage at Themberchaud's treatment
fact: Grygum, as a cleric of Bahamut, is appalled at how Themberchaud is treated and agrees to the plan.
source_quote: Grygum smiles, “As a cleric of Bahamut, I am appalled at how they treat Themberchaud. Let’s do it.”
